confidence_note: Clinic origin, referral purpose, eight-week course and Part I practices come from Wikipedia's account of the book; weekly format and self-reported results come from a Tricycle editorial introduction that says the book 'outlines the clinic's program' but is not the book itself. Old text's outcome claims (pain, sleep, anxiety 'measured'), invented dialogue and the 'small room' were dropped.
facts: The Stress Reduction Clinic at the University of Massachusetts Medical Center was founded in 1979 by Kabat-Zinn; the book grew out of its work.
It was a referral service for patients who were falling through the cracks of health care, with a wide range of diagnoses, not responding completely to traditional treatment.
The eight-week Stress Reduction and Relaxation Program, later MBSR, taught mindfulness meditation and mindful hatha yoga.
Part I covers the body scan, mindfulness of breathing, mindful yoga, walking meditation and mindfulness of daily activities such as eating.
Per a Tricycle introduction: a 2.5-hour weekly class of about thirty people, 45 minutes of practice a day six days a week, a day-long silent retreat.
The same introduction reports more than five thousand participants, diagnoses from cancer and AIDS to back pain and panic attacks, and 85 percent self-reporting significant symptom reduction.
MBSR is offered in more than 740 hospitals, clinics and stand-alone programs (Wikipedia).
scene_details: A class of about thirty people.
Forty-five minutes of practice a day, six days a week.
tension: A hospital offered patients who were not responding fully to treatment an eight-week course in paying attention.
opening_idea: Start with the patients the clinic took and what it gave them.

lessons.idea: Attention is trained by a daily routine, not decided once.
lessons.anchor: Forty-five minutes a day, six days a week for eight weeks.

reflect_final: Which regular moment of your day could hold a few minutes of simply noticing what is happening?

use_cases.move: The clinic started its class with practice, so I'll open with one minute of quiet before we start.
Spend a few minutes on one ordinary activity, like washing up, and notice only that.
Choose one daily activity and give it your full attention.

pocket_idea: Eight weeks of daily practice in paying attention was the clinic's whole course.

conversation_variants.punchline_idea: The clinic's answer for patients medicine could not fully help was a course in paying attention.
conversation_variants.thirty_sec_idea: The 1979 clinic, the eight-week course, the daily practice.
